args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living
args.body:
June,

A note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". It needs relabelling to Pellow Home Living.
- "PHL" also stands for Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast terminal rows), so filter by the full name, not the acronym.

Sofia
